sources.note: Town of Norwich, Board of Listers page (live): Ernie Ciccotelli (term to 2027) and Pamela Smith (term to 2027) sit as listers alongside Chair ('Ernie' is the diminutive of Ernest Ciccotelli, whose existing person record is reused) Cheryl Lindberg (already recorded); both act in the listers' minutes of July 30, 2026.

Seating-basis disclosure for Smith: the town's pre-election candidate-forms page described her seat as 'Lister (2 year unexpired term - Smith, appointed)' -- she first held the seat by appointment going into March 2026, and no election result naming her was located; she is recorded as appointed on that documented basis, still presented as a sitting lister on the town's live listers page.
